latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of all-to-markdown.
- Convert various file formats (PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, images, audio, web pages, ZIP archives) and URLs to Markdown using Microsoft MarkItDown.
- Supports document OCR, audio transcription, YouTube subtitle extraction, and EXIF/image metadata.
- Command-line usage provided with flexible options for file paths, URLs, and output.
- AI can utilize the tool to facilitate Markdown conversion for easier content analysis.
